MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-android-00' AND n.caller_name = 'getTopMostActivity' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-kotlin-compiler-00' AND n.caller_name = 'getName' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id AS missing, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY name, id SKIP 2 LIMIT 12
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-android-00' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id DESC SKIP 2 LIMIT 12
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller ORDER BY caller SKIP 0 LIMIT 2
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY n.callee_name DESC SKIP 0 LIMIT 2
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.caller_name AS x, n.callee_name AS x ORDER BY x SKIP 2 LIMIT 8
MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS name ORDER BY name DESC, callee SKIP 1 LIMIT 3
